newsitem.title: USA: First Financial Caribbean says sets split.
newsitem.headline: First Financial Caribbean says sets split.

text.p: First Financial Carribean Corp said Thursday it declared a two-for-one split on its common stock.
The split will be effected in the form of a stock dividend of one additional share of common stock to be issued on August 28, for each share of common stock held of record as of August 18.
Before the declaration of the split, the company had 9,682,158 fully diluted shares outstanding.
Following distribution of the additional shares, the company will have 19,364,316 fully diluted shares outstanding.
The split will not be dilutive to voting rights or shareholders' proportionate interest in the company.
